lock_during_import: Completed opaque copy may be adopted at next unlock; orphan path uses ID as display name and sets default only when none exists, so verify default marker and use Set default if needed.
rollback: At idle, Models → existing 3B row Set default. Row tap only opens details. Default setter changes preference only; next admitted turn loads captured selected model. Preserve both model rows/files.

cpu_findings.supported_opportunity: Measured long actual prompts cause substantial CPU prefill work; shorter actual prompts or smaller qualified model are candidates for controlled comparison, not established fixes. No retrieval thresholds or gold changes proposed.
